//! The Acme client.

use std::fmt;

/// How long a call waits.
pub const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS: u64 = 5_000;

pub(crate) static INTERNAL: &str = "x";

/// Talks to the API.
///
/// Cheap to clone.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Client {
    base: String,
}

pub struct Pair(pub u8, pub u8);

/// What went wrong.
pub enum Error {
    Timeout,
    Status(u16),
}

/** Sends requests. */
pub trait Transport: Send + Sync {
    /// Sends one request.
    fn send(&self, body: &[u8]) -> std::result::Result<Vec<u8>, Error>;

    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "transport"
    }
}

pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;

impl Client {
    /// Builds a client.
    pub fn new(base: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self { base: base.into() }
    }

    fn sign(&self) -> u8 {
        0
    }

    pub async fn list<T>(&self, limit: usize) -> Result<Vec<T>>
    where
        T: fmt::Debug,
    {
        Ok(Vec::new())
    }
}

impl fmt::Display for Client {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{}", self.base)
    }
}

pub mod auth {
    /// A bearer token.
    pub fn token() -> String {
        String::new()
    }

    fn secret() {}
}

mod private {
    pub fn hidden() {}
}

fn helper() {}
